script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: Paul is called an apostle, a fact from outside this passage, without a reference.
A house is a building. The text also doesn't say whether it had a steeple.
The text says the church meets at the house, not specifically in a living room.
Saying the news keeps reaching Paul adds repeated reports; he says he hears about Philemon's faith and love.
The last two sentences merely restate that two things are named. The explanation feels flat and generic.
Paul chooses to appeal on the basis of love, but the text doesn't describe his voice as gentle.
The text doesn't establish that nobody is visiting a doctor.
Onesimus getting that welcome is stated as an outcome. Paul asks Philemon to receive him that way; the letter doesn't report the outcome.
‘Whatever debt there is’ assumes a debt exists. Paul says if Onesimus owes anything.
‘The cost lands on Paul’ treats a possible debt as established and charged. Paul makes a conditional offer.
‘The debt goes to Paul’ treats a possible debt as established and transferred. Paul makes a conditional offer.
Calling Epaphras a fellow prisoner doesn't establish that he and Paul shared chains or a cell. The guess marker applies to what the note means, not to the claimed cell.
The text calls Epaphras a fellow prisoner, but doesn't say he is sitting in prison alongside Paul.
The text calls Epaphras a fellow prisoner, but doesn't establish that he is in prison with Paul.
